structured.answer: According to the page, the cheapest option is an account at פסגות with the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125": about 86,000 ₪ left after 10 years and only about 1,049 ₪ in costs, compared with 6,500–10,500 ₪ at the big banks. But I don't know this site or Psagot, so I'll ask my son before I do anything.
